description: This file defines the 'DeviceListActivity' class in an Android application, responsible for displaying a list of paired and discovered Bluetooth devices for user selection, and returning the selected device's MAC address.

classes.name: DeviceListActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays Bluetooth devices (paired and discovered) for user selection, and returns the chosen device's address.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI, sets up device lists, registers broadcast receivers, and populates the list of currently paired Bluetooth devices.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by canceling discovery and unregistering broadcast receivers.

methods.name: doDiscovery
methods.description: Starts the Bluetooth device discovery process, updating UI indicators.
